translations.web: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
translations.bsb: He thwarts the schemes of the crafty, so that their hands find no success.
translations.kjv: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
translations.asv: He frustrateth the devices of the crafty, So that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
